_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Simulator link checks now use the native Arduino reader and ProSim polling timestamps, so delayed GUI delivery does not falsely abort a trial. Real stale links and hardware fault protections remain active.

Recording PDFs render in a separate serialized process. Closing a recording keeps live telemetry responsive and preserves the exact CSV/JSON paths. Report errors retain data and do not stop measurements. Window close stops and vents hardware before waiting for pending reports.

Validated with 36 focused Simulator/report tests, layout audit and mocked GUI smoke on each branch. Firmware, PID, calibration, Max presets and NI reference timing are unchanged.
